faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Office Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Office Helper (Project Support Staff-I) position is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The essential educational qualification is a 12th Pass (Matriculation/High School) from a recognised Board. A three-year Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University in any discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Office Helper position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Office Helper (Project Support Staff-I) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,460/- per month (Gross) for this contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Office Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Office Helper (Project Support Staff-I) at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a Written Test/Skill Test (if required) followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Nagpur, www.aiimsnagpur.edu.in. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
